verdict.rationale: Next.js is documented as a React framework whose React components can be made async to await data. Styling options include CSS Modules and Tailwind, and community reports confirm component-scoped CSS (styled-jsx) and TypeScript use. This supports writing logic and styles in a component, though co-locating markup with rendering logic is implied rather than explicitly described. missing for 10: explicit documentation of JSX/markup co-located with logic in one component, explicit statement that components use standard JS/TS, independent hands-on corroboration of the single-component authoring experience.

support.subject: As a developer, I can write markup and rendering logic together in a single component using markup, styles, and a language I already know

citations.quote: Next.js is a React framework for building full-stack web applications.
Make your React component async and await your data.
Style your application with your favorite tools, including support for CSS Modules, Tailwind CSS, and popular community libraries.
calls it a great isomorphic TS framework
